frame_indexing.basis: website convention supplied as context; not independently verified from this paste

source.authority: reported reference data; source labels and values preserved, not physics-authoritative

interpretation.active_bounds: headline bounds only; intervening frames may be inactive; see verbatim notes
interpretation.damage_values: ordered as displayed; slash-separated values have no inferred strong/weak mapping
interpretation.missing_fields: absent means not displayed; explicit blank/dash/None values are null with source status
interpretation.protection: Inv. notation preserved; intangibility versus invulnerability not inferred
interpretation.timing: source frame numbers unchanged; no elapsed-frame subtraction or derived endlag
interpretation.stats: source labels preserved; reported_fast_fall_speed may not correspond to game fast-fall velocity
